item.title: [Injury] Steven Adams: Steven Adams (calf) is a game time decision against the Mavs
item.description:
Steven Adams (calf) is a game time decision against the Mavs

If Adams were to miss time, Clint Capela will likely end up taking the backup center minutes for the Rockets. Adams isn’t likely to impact most fantasy leagues anyway.

Fonte: Will Guillory

item.title: Bilal Coulibaly: The Wizards will start Trae Young, Kyshawn George, Bilal Coulibaly, Anthony Davis, and Alex Sarr against Bucks on Wednesday
item.description:
The Wizards will start Trae Young, Kyshawn George, Bilal Coulibaly, Anthony Davis, and Alex Sarr against Bucks on Wednesday

Bilal Coulibaly will take the starting spot of AJ Dybantsa who rolled his ankle in the final pre-season game against the Pelicans. Bilal is worth a stream spot in redraft leagues if he’s available.
